guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：數位鑑識證據保全
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Digital-forensics evidence preservation
guides.concept: 以可追溯、完整且可重現的數位證據串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect traceable, intact and reproducible digital evidence with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「合法與任務範圍」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：證據接觸需限定資料、目的與處理授權。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用自建測試檔描述可分析與不可分析區域。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「採集變更」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：採集工具自身可能造成可觀察系統變更。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「列出玩具工具可能產生的日誌與時間戳。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「雜湊完整性」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：密碼雜湊可偵測位元變更但不證明內容真實。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「修改自製副本一個位元並比較摘要。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「檔案與磁區」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：檔案系統配置與未配置區不能混為一談。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「在自製映像對照目錄項與位元範圍。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「採集吞吐」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：讀寫瓶頸與驗證次數共同決定耗時。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「重算本課映像採集與驗證下限。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「儲存與刪除」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：儲存期限、存取與合規要求需獨立管理。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「在假想流程列出儲存、到期及例外批准。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for authority and scope. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Evidence access is bounded by data, purpose and authority. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Define analyzable areas on self-created test files. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for collection alteration. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Collection tools may themselves change observed state. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: List logs and timestamps a toy collector may change. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for hash integrity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Cryptographic hashes detect changes, not content truth. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Change one bit in a self-made copy and compare digests. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for files and sectors. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Allocated files and unallocated regions differ. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare directory entries with byte ranges in a self-made image. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for collection throughput. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Read/write bottlenecks and verification passes set duration. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate collection and verification time bounds. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for retention and deletion. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retention, access and compliance requirements are managed separately. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Specify retention, expiry and exceptions in a fictional workflow. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「報告重現」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只有截圖即可完整重現分析。」為何不成立。
提交「儲存與刪除」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「在假想流程列出儲存、到期及例外批准。」如何辨別它們。
提交「儲存與刪除」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「證據越多儲存越久永遠越好。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for report reproduction; explain why this claim fails: Screenshots alone fully reproduce analysis.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for retention and deletion; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for retention and deletion; explain why this claim fails: Keeping more evidence forever is always better.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：證據越多儲存越久永遠越好。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Keeping more evidence forever is always better. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

guides.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
guides.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

courses.overview: 從可追溯、完整且可重現的數位證據延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend traceable, intact and reproducible digital evidence to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

practice: 畫出本課與「資安事件應變演練」共用的資料／元件介面；以「兩者都建立帶可信度的時間線」指出能保留的條件。

practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with cybersecurity incident-response exercises; use "Both construct confidence-aware timelines" to identify retained conditions.
For "Forensics does not make rapid restoration its sole aim", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.
